rule.drilling: Archived extractor main: calendar (TD - spud).days, missing dates filled with zero. Above 250 calendar days, use union_days on WAR intervals clipped to spud..TD when intervals exist; otherwise retain calendar days. union_days merges overlaps and sums exclusive (end - start).days per merged interval; adjacent intervals stay separate. The 250-day branch is an archived implementation detail, not an engineering acceptance limit.
rule.completion: Archived derive_completion_days: count distinct normalized WAR days at or after TD, inclusive, using intervals joined to remarks by SN_WAR; no activity-code filter, first-oil bound or gap cutoff. Fill one missing endpoint from the other. Missing TD, empty joined rows or no qualifying days return zero. Later servicing may be included; remarks-absent WAR intervals may be omitted.
rule.missing_values: Preserve original day counts, including historical zero fills. A zero is an archived output value, not evidence of measured zero activity.
rule.pnd: No separate historical PND measurement exists in this workbook. Leave PND_DAYS null. The unfiltered post-TD completion rule can include PND-coded intervals when present in its joined input, but their contribution cannot be recovered from these totals. PND remains an opaque code.
rule.coverage: The workbook records neither a coverage status nor sufficient weekly history to establish completeness. Apply historical_coverage_unknown to every frozen row; infer no measured, absent-coverage or unattributed-coverage status from dates or zeros.
